changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0029. Support tenant-scoped membership activity charts. Index review: PK and existing membership indexes stay; IX_MembershipHistory_TenantId_CreatedAt does not seek EffectiveDate; IX_MembershipHistory_TenantId_EffectiveDate (TenantId, EffectiveDate, Action) seeks one gym's history for a date range and groups created, renewed, and expired actions. Member joins stay on IX_MemberProfiles_TenantId_Status, which already includes JoinDate. Check-ins stay on IX_Attendance_TenantId_CheckInTime. Performance note: the new index leads with TenantId so a dashboard range never scans another gym's history.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IX_MembershipHistory_TenantId_EffectiveDate ON app.MembershipHistory (TenantId, EffectiveDate, Action);
